Projectbeschrijving: Dit project onderzoekt de toepassing van op foto-elektrokatalyse (PEC) gebaseerde geavanceerde oxidatie (AOP) als effectieve techniek om organische microverontreinigingen uit gezuiverd afvalwater te verwijderen.

Projecttitel: A (bio)analytical platform to assess hazards of transformation products formed during water treatment
Projectbeschrijving: Advanced oxidation processes (AOPs) play an important role to degrade micropollutants like pharmaceuticals and pesticides present in water. However, during treatment, so called transformation products (TPs) might be formed as micropollutants are not completely mineralised. These TPs can have significantly different characteristics compared to their parent compound and, in some cases, might still be biologically active.
Aanvrager: Stichting Wetsus, European Centre Of Excellence For Sustainable Water Technology

Projecttitel: Nonlinear acoustics for detection and assessment of PVC water mains
Projectbeschrijving: The inspection of drinking water supply mains is critical to determine the remaining lifespan of pipes and to reduce costs while enabling better water supply with high-quality drinking water and reducing downtime of water supply. The lack of an inline inspection method for PVC pipes, which are commonly used in the Netherlands and are on average 50 years old, is a significant problem.
Aanvrager: Stichting Wetsus, European Centre Of Excellence For Sustainable Water Technology

Projecttitel: (Hyper)Thermophilic digestion of blackwater: optimisation for recovery of energy and organic matter, and (micro)nutrients for reuse in agriculture
Projectbeschrijving: Wastewater is conventionally treated after dilution with appreciable amounts of clean drinking water. Recovery of resources in that case is only limited. By collecting blackwater separately valuable elements are present in a concentrated form. This stream can then be treated anaerobically allowing simultaneous resource recovery and energy production while producing fertilisers usable in agriculture.
Aanvrager: Stichting Wetsus, European Centre Of Excellence For Sustainable Water Technology

Projecttitel: Biological manganese removal as pre-treatment to limit (bio)fouling in oligotrophic conditions
Projectbeschrijving: During different water treatment processes, such as in drinking water production, the accumulation of insoluble Mn oxides can result in membrane fouling, recognizable by the black coloration of the fouling layers, often causing irreversible fouling. The conventional drinking water treatment process has a relatively low removal performance of Mn.
Aanvrager: Stichting Wetsus, European Centre Of Excellence For Sustainable Water Technology

Projecttitel: Iron oxide adsorbents and regeneration strategies for phosphate recovery
Projectbeschrijving: Phosphorus (P) is an essential nutrient for life and fundamental for food production sustainability. It is obtained from phosphate rock mines (present in a few countries), mainly to produce fertilizers. Through agricultural run-off and sewage effluent, P ends up in water, where it accumulates. Already at concentrations > 10 µg/L it can promote eutrophication and algae blooms. Therefore, it is crucial to remove P from water to ultra-low concentrations and to recover it.
Aanvrager: Stichting Wetsus, European Centre Of Excellence For Sustainable Water Technology

Projectbeschrijving: The aim of this project is to develop methods to prepare PV panels for re-use at end-of-life, turning waste into a useful product again. This will be approached by rebuilding of new PV panels based on components recovered from end-of-life PV panels.

Projecttitel: Sustainable Contact Technology for Silicon Heterojunction Solar Cells
Projectbeschrijving: The goal of the project is to develop high-performance alternatives for silver metallization and indium-oxide-based contact layers in HJT cells. The project supports the business cases and sustainability of HJT PV, as well as high efficiency and local manufacturing, which is in line with the objectives of the MMIP2.

Projectbeschrijving: Het doel van DHARA is om met gebruik van de juiste data aan te tonen hoe het risico op seismiciteit bij geothermie ingeschat en beheerst kan worden; een nodige stap voor schaalvergroting van geothermie (MMIP4). Aanvrager: Nederlandse Organisatie voor toegepast-natuurwetenschappelijk Onderzoek TNO

Projectbeschrijving: Het opstellen en faciliteren van een toetsingskader (middels een te ontwikkelen protocol) voor de legionellaveiligheid van innovatieve warmtapwatertechnologie bij LT-warmtenetten. Het bredere doel hierachter is (1) snellere implementatie van bewezen veilige, LT-warmtapwatertechnologie bij LT-warmtenetten en (2) stimulatie van innovatie op het gebied van LT-warmtapwater.

Projectbeschrijving: Het projectdoel is om in een gebied (Californie) met bewezen geothermiepotentieel een datagedreven aanpak te ontwikkelen waarmee de seismische dreiging bij aardwarmtewinning bepaald kan worden en de seismische risico’s in voldoende mate beheerst kunnen worden, opdat het winnen van aardwarmte in van nature seismisch actieve gebieden met verbreukte gesteentelagen onder acceptabele condities kan worden vervolgd.

Projecttitel: Ontwikkeling van een kosteneffectieve en duurzame Redox Flow Batterij (RFB)
Projectbeschrijving: Het doel van het project NewBAT is het ontwikkelen en implementeren van een duurzame kostengunstige op quinonen gebaseerde RFBs met een nieuw reactorcelontwerp waardoor fluctuaties in hernieuwbare energieopwekking kunnen worden opgevangen. Door de lange continue afgifte tijd (tot 20 uur) is de RFB in de gebouwde omgeving uiterst competitief met lithium-ion batterijen.

Projecttitel: Reactive Power Management in the Transmission and Distribution Network
Projectbeschrijving: De doelstelling van REACT-D is om een goede voorspelling van de benodigde hoeveelheid blindvermogen op een bepaald moment, voor een bepaalde periode op een bepaalde plaats in het net te kunnen maken zodat er lokaal en door duurzame bronnen gecompenseerd kan worden. Dit project zet de eerste stap om het mogelijk te maken dat blindvermogen niet meer van een centraal punt over het hele net getransporteerd hoeft te worden waardoor meer transport- en distributiecapaciteit beschikbaar blijft voor actieve energiestromen, en energieverliezen en inkoopkosten voor blindvermogen tot een minimum behouden blijven en leveringszekerheid gewaarborgd blijft.

Projecttitel: AI4ROAD - AI-Based IT solutions for Green and Resilient Road-transport planning
Projectbeschrijving: The road transport sector is facing grand sustainability challenges. Sustainability targets on a local, national, and international level are currently set. For instance, in 2025 large businesses need to account for their CO2 emissions, including those by external logistics parties. In the future, only more sustainability measures and regulations are to be expected. At the same time, the sector faces grand technological challenges. Electric or hydrogen powered trucks are on the verge of a breakthrough. Furthermore, the world market is facing more-and-more disruptions..The road-transport sector is challenged by these developments on sustainability and technology, and the increase of uncertainty and disruptions. The current way of planning does not suffice anymore. Operations become extremely dynamic and multiple objectives should be balanced (sustainability, fairness, cost). Sustainability is expected to become a main driver for planning, instead of costs. For the SMEs in the road transport sector, no IT planning software exist that is tailored to their specific needs. Software is rigid and cannot deal with new situations and planning constraints easily. The AI4ROAD project is a collaboration of the Eindhoven AI Institute at the TU/e and Van der Wal. It consists of two industrial research projects that leverage the potential of Artificial Intelligence (AI) for new IT software for sustainable and resilient planning.

Projecttitel: HASTA - Healthy Ageing Starts with a healthy sTArt
Projectbeschrijving: The Netherlands has a relatively high perinatal mortality rate, as more than a thousand fetuses and neonates die every year during pregnancy, delivery or in the first weeks after birth. More than half of these deaths could be prevented if the (unborn) infant could be monitored 24 hours a day. In addition, around 7% of all babies were born prematurely (before 37 weeks gestational age) and most premature babies need hospital care in their first days or even weeks of life. The care environment is needed to prevent deterioration, however has a negative influence on the growth and maturation of the infants due to the disturbances in sleep and in bonding to the parents. Over the years, research has shown that these hospitalized infants are at risk of disturbed sleep/wake patterns, that remain even for a longer time after discharge from the hospital, resulting in decreased growth and delays in brain maturation. At school-going age often cognitive and behavioral delays are still observed and they have a higher risk on heart and vascular disease later in life.

Projecttitel: RAPTURE - Robust dAta ProducTs and fair Resource allocation for EDA
Projectbeschrijving: There is a growing need for a robust data architecture that provides a high-performing AI compute capacity in the context of Electronic Design Applications (EDA). NXP's technical solution currently heavily draws data from a centralized data-lake that combines and partially cures data from a series of edge-enabled and hybrid cloud data sources. Currently, data pipelines are developed for the purpose of specific ML/AI jobs. Unfortunately, however, this centralistic approaches comes with various challenges. Firstly, the operational capacity of such a centralized data team can become a serious bottleneck for robust and scalable data sharing. Secondly, since the centralized team is logically separated from the (decentral) business domains, it becomes exceedingly difficult to serve high-quality data in line with the consumer’s needs. Lastly, it becomes ever more challenging to (re) develop, deploy and manage high-performance compute data pipelines as their number grows quickly.

Projecttitel: HVCLD - High-Velocity Contact Line Dynamics for High-Speed Immersion
Projectbeschrijving: Immersion lithography is a key fabrication method for semiconductor devices. By using double and quadruple patterning, structures with dimensions below the Rayleigh resolution limit can be achieved, but at the expense of additional process steps and a correspondingly lower factory output. Consequently, any means to increase the production rate of immersion lithography without introducing a higher defect density is commercially highly desirable. The wafer stage velocity, and thus the throughput of the system, is determined by the mobility of water contact lines on the .photoresist-covered wafers. This mobility can be diminished e.g. by pre-existing topographic features on a wafer or chemical heterogeneities. Two further limitations are given by the tendency of a thin liquid film to entrain at the wafer edge (“film pulling”) and splashing to occur, when the immersion hood moves across the edge of the wafer. Generally no residual water should be left on the photoresist, as this can lead to so-called watermark defects. The goal of this project is to elucidate the impact of heterogeneities on the maximum possible process speed of immersion lithography and to evaluate strategies to eliminate or minimize water loss as a consequence of film pulling or splashing.

The increasing integration of renewable energy sources and new electronic loads (such as electric vehicles) motivated by the energy transition has posed new technical challenges to the traditional electric distribution grid. In fact, such integration may result in voltage limit violations, current congestion, harmonic pollution, and protection issue. It can have a huge impact on the performance and reliability of the grid. In this scenario, power electronics can play an important role to solve many of these problems and improve the stability and reliability of the distribution grid. In particular, there is an emerging technology based on a power electronics converter call Solid-State Transformer that is able to solve most of the problems mentioned above while providing additional benefits in terms of controllability, power density, and integration of storage energy systems. Solid-state transformer (also called SST) is a power electronics-based system with high control capability that is supposed to replace the traditional low-frequency transformer of the electric grid. It can control voltages and currents of the electric grid, providing, therefore, mean services to the grid, such as: load imbalance reduction, harmonics reduction, and congestion control, besides managing efficiently the integration of storage energy elements and renewable energy sources to the grid. Even though the SST has a huge potential to be a game-changer for the future distribution grid, it is still a new technology and there are many challenges in terms of efficiency, reliability, and cost that must be overcome to make this technology mature. In this context, this project will investigate an efficient and reliable SST solution for future distribution grids.

Projecttitel: ALBATROS - Advanced systems and soLutions for Better practices AgainsT hazaRds in the aviatiOn System
Projectbeschrijving: ALBATROS overarching ambition is to maintain a high level of safety in aviation in view of extreme weather conditions, expected changes brought about by the evolution of aviation systems especially new fuel and energy systems (including hydrogen) which will be integrated in the coming years to both future aircraft and airport infrastructures. ALBATROS activities target the increased resilience against safety issues both on the ground and in flight to ensure the survival of passengers and crew as well as their evacuation and rescue in case of emergencies. ALBATROS objectives are to: - Develop a concept for real?time sharing of safety intelligence to support decision making on safety issues, emergencies and crises; - Develop safety risk models and analyse safety data for prediction and prevention of emerging and future hazards in aviation (linked to Data4Safety); - Develop survivability measures to mitigate safety issues and risks; - Assess and improve human performance and develop best practices for decision making in the handling of crises and emergency situations; - Validate and demonstrate concepts, technologies and decision support tools (exercises at airports, simulations and laboratory tests conducted in close collaboration with EACCC, GADSS and ACI-Europe); - Disseminate, communicate, and exploit project key results and outcomes (including through emergency response training & exercises). ALBATROS will work on maturing technologies and solutions up to TRL6 which will be compatible with EACCC and GADSS requirements. Initially, scenarios, requirements, concepts of use and relevant technologies will be agreed upon, before development activities are performed on safety modelling and data analysis, survivability as well as decision support tools and best practices. The results of these developments will then be integrated and validated through 15 demonstrations in relevant environments across Europe (airports, flight simulators or crisis centres).
Aanvrager: Stichting Koninklijk Nederlands Lucht- en Ruimtevaartcentrum

Projecttitel: GIANCE - Graphene Alliance for Sustainable Multifunctional Materials to Tackle Environmental Challenges;
Projectbeschrijving: GIANCE is a 3-year long project funded by Horizon Europe. The consortium consists of 23 partners from 10 countries, representing the full value chain, with leading OEMs, large industries, world-class research and education organisations, and innovative SMEs. GIANCE presents creative solutions to environmental challenges by establishing a comprehensive and industry-driven platform. This platform aims to design, develop, and produce the next generation of affordable, eco-friendly, lightweight, and recyclable materials based on graphene and related substances (GRM). These materials include multifunctional composites, coatings, foams, and membranes (GRM-bM) with enhanced properties, such as thermal, mechanical, and chemical features.
Aanvrager: Stichting Koninklijk Nederlands Lucht- en Ruimtevaartcentrum

Projecttitel: D-STANDART - Durability Modelling Of Composite Structures With Arbitrary Lay-Up Using Standardised Testing And Artificial Intelligence
Projectbeschrijving: WHAT? To develop fast and efficient methods to characterise the fatigue properties of composite materials, and thereby model the durability of large-scale composite structures with arbitrary lay-ups under realistic conditions (loads, environment, manufacturing/effect of defect) HOW? Through minimal and accelerated testing of generic specimens Transferring the results of the experiments to large-scale structures using artificial intelligence and machine learning EFFECT? Enabling reduced time-to-market, material waste, and increased lifespan of composite products in the aerospace and wind energy industries
Aanvrager: Stichting Koninklijk Nederlands Lucht- en Ruimtevaartcentrum

Projecttitel: COCOLIH2T - Composite Conformal Liquid H2 Tank
Projectbeschrijving: The safe and efficient storage of H2 on-board future aircraft is the essential enabler of H2 technologies and will be one of the most complex aerospace engineering challenges that the industry has ever faced. COCOLIH2T (COmposite COnformal LIquid H2 Tank) project, led by Collins Aerospace, is proposing a disruptive concept focused on reducing the impact of the tank’s weight and volume within an aircraft, while ensuring system safety. COCOLIH2T will not only develop a safe composite and vacuum insulated LH2 tank for the aviation sector but has the ambition to go beyond by designing and manufacturing a conformal tank through novel fabrication technologies enabling a reduction of more than 60% in production energy consumption, at least 50% in production time leading to significantly lower manufacturing costs. Additionally, the proposed structure of the tank, based on a multi-material thermoplastic composite concept, is intended to facilitate aircraft structural integration to support overall system weight reduction compared with conventional tank configurations. COCOLIH2T’s overall system will be demonstrated at TRL4 by the end of the project. COCOLIH2T started in February 2023 and will run for 36 months. COCOLIH2T is a project funded by the Clean Hydrogen Joint Undertaking (JU) under the Horizon Europe programme. The project was selected after successful submission to the call HORIZON-JTI-CLEANH2-2022-1 and more specifically the topic HORIZON-JTI-CLEANH2-2022-03-07 “Development of specific aviation cryogenic storage system with a gauging, fuel metering, heat management and monitoring system” (Pillar 3.1 Hydrogen end uses – Transport applications of the Clean Hydrogen JU Scientific Research Innovation Agenda or SRIA). COCOLIH2T is a Research and Innovation Action (RIA).
Aanvrager: Stichting Koninklijk Nederlands Lucht- en Ruimtevaartcentrum

Projectbeschrijving: The TRISTAN consortium aims to expand, mature and industrialize the European RISC-V ecosystem to compete with existing commercial/proprietary alternatives. This will be achieved by leveraging the Open-Source community to gain in productivity and quality. This goal will be achieved by defining a European strategy for RISC-V-based designs, including the creation of a repository of industrial quality building blocks to be used for SoC designs in different application domains (e.g. automotive, industrial, etc.). The TRISTAN approach is holistic, covering electronic design automation tools (EDA) and the full software stack.
Aanvrager: Stichting Koninklijk Nederlands Lucht- en Ruimtevaartcentrum

Projectbeschrijving: The goal of this project is to develop an efficient 50 W @ 80 K cryocooler consuming 1 kW of electricity using the Free Piston Stirling Platform developed by Microgen Engine Corporation. The manufacturing expertise gained in developing the engine will be leveraged and used to develop the cryocooler. Stirling cryocooler operate with oscillating pressure and flow. The key component is the regenerator where the hot and cold streams flow in the same channel, but at different times. Heat is stored for a half cycle in the heat capacity of the porous material. Porous materials with high permeability, smaller pores, smaller wall thickness and high porosity need to be investigated. Additive manufacturing methods will be investigated. This proposal primarily fits well within the scope and ambitions of the TKI HTSM Advanced Instrumentation roadmap. More specifically this fits in the following aim of the roadmap; Innovate advanced key technologies for application development in the health ? and energy & sustainability sector[page 4/26].

Projecttitel: DART - Data-driven Analysis for hybrid x-Ray meTrology
Projectbeschrijving: We will develop the global minimisation procedure optimised for minimising a combined set of various data types and capable of working with 10 to 70 fit parameters with the approach for the statistical analysis of obtained solutions. This approach will be demonstrated by solving standard X-ray characterization challenges. The proposed research is essential for developing laboratory X-ray metrology equipment suppliers and applied by thin film production industries and as such fits.perfectly to the Advanced instrumentation TKI Roadmap.

Projecttitel: MCO2 - Microreactor-assisted Carbonation of Olivine to study CO2 Negative Building Materials
Projectbeschrijving: In this project we want to study the carbonation reaction of olivine particles as a function of solvent composition (aqueous vs super critical CO2), shear (flow), saturation and/or continuous removal of reaction products (mass transport), temperature, pressure, bicarbonate and other ionic concentrations, pH, oxalic and/or ascorbic acid (organic ligands), and the size (and mining source) of the particles. This proposal fits with HTSM roadmap High Tech Materials and aligns specifically to Europe's Green Deal as it proposes alternative production routes that limit CO2 emissions to produce building (and mining) materials. In addition, this proposal fits to the key technology (KT) Chemical Technologies, as it extensively employs the use of microreactors, and analytic technologies, while studying catalytic processes. As a final step in this project, we also intend to use (electrophoretic) separation technology. Additionally, it fits to the Nanotechnologies KT, as it employs nanomanufacturing at the MESA+ Nanolab cleanroom, producing microfluidic chips and it fits the Advanced Materials key technology for its game-changing know-how in new structural materials.

Project CAL is about providing early warnings when a hosted and distributed application on IoT devices and its OT back end in a SaaS offering is going awry. CAL uses a set of application sensors in the distributed applications to assess if that application is behaving normally, or if the application due to security or IoT/OT breakage events is starting to behave erratically. CAL is analogous to a car's Check Engine Light - it is an early indicator engine service - in CAL an indicator identifies that the application is under duress e.g., by way of hacking events, (parts of) the distributed application has failed (through normal or induced events), operating (extremely) slowly, or that uncommon data streams in the application are identified.

Projecttitel: Accurate Real-Time Parameter Estimation - Accurate real-time parameter estimation for instrumentation and condition monitoring
Projectbeschrijving: The scientific goal of the project is to provide fundamental research and development on parameter estimation algorithms in a generic sense. These developments enable a wide range of applications for advanced instrumentation systems by overcoming d in real-world applications. These include the presence of noisy environments with strong disturbances,.unmodeled and complex dynamics, et cetera.

Projecttitel: CoCoLi - Complexity COnstrained Light-coherent optical links
Projectbeschrijving: Data center interconnects (DCIs) use optical fibers to connect two or more data centers. DCI  bandwidth is expected grow at more than 50% CAGR over the next five years. The short-distance DCI area (between 2 and 10 km) is of special interest for customers operating data centers. Current solutions are based on intensity modulation/direct detection (IMDD). Next generation solutions are expected to be faster, more power efficient, and operate under strict latency requirements. IM/DD technologies cannot satisfy these requirements and thus are now being replaced by “light-coherent” technologies, where both the amplitude and the phase of the optical field carries information. The .overall goal of this project is to develop DSP techniques for next- generation light-coherent transponders. The main idea is to design systems in terms of maintaining the complexity limited and not based on performance.

Projecttitel: ADNPC - Anormal dispersive nanocomposite polymers for chromatic correction of lenses
Projectbeschrijving: The project will study and develop stable homogenous polymer nanocomposites (preferably UV curable) with the required anormal optical dispersion properties and low light scattering. It is a major challenge to prevent light scattering due to agglomeration of the nanoparticles in the composite polymer matrix. The project will therefore study different routes to agglomerate-free nanocomposites via a) mixing of different nanoparticle formulations in optical polymers, b) in-situ chemical synthesis of the nanoparticles from a liquid resin and c) formation of a nanocrystalline phase in the polymer through a temperature treatment. The optical refractive index and dispersion properties of the resulting composite materials, manufactured via three different processing routes, will be characterized together with the curing kinetics, adhesion, and mechanical properties of the polymer coatings. Replication of the new materials on glass lenses will be tested using Anteryon's replication technology. ASML and Anteryon will characterize the lens quality.

Projecttitel: PERSEUS - Patient-centered Exploration for Reliable Smart and Efficient Utilization of healthcare Services
Projectbeschrijving: PERSEUS contributes to these goals via MedTech innovations towards cloud-based image-guided therapy; measurement and optimization of the impact of value-based healthcare in cardiovascular hospital healthcare; development of cardiovascular prediction models based on national data registries; development of a staging area and an interactive dashboard for ICU vital signs; biomarker-based follow-up scheduling of heart failure patients; candidate identification tool for ventricular assist devices; and postdilation optimization after stent deployment. PERSEUS addresses key areas of the HTSM Health roadmap: Healthy Living and Prevention, Diagnosis and Therapy and Home and Community Care. Moreover, it contributes to MedTech innovation and the KIA Health & Care mission Zorg in de Leefomgeving.

Projecttitel: SAVE HER - SAVEmothers by reducing postnatal HEmoRrhage
Projectbeschrijving: SAVE HER contributes to the reduction of postnatal hemorrhage via innovations in the monitoring of perinatal uterine activity, using unobtrusive technology, that can be used both in the hospital and home setting. The monitoring application and AI-based methods will be tested first in the hospital and in the last phase of the project, a pilot to test the technology in a 'home@hospital' setting is aimed for. SAVE HER addresses key areas of the HTSM Health roadmap: Healthy Living and Prevention, Diagnosis and Therapy and Home and Community Care. Moreover, it contributes toMedTech innovation and the KIA Health & Care mission Zorg in de Leefomgeving.

InPhoTherm realizes this goal via the existing e/MTIC collaboration between TU/e, Catharina Hospital and Amazec Photonics. The new technology will be developed and tested first in clinical trials involving healthy volunteers, and in later phases on patients during heart surgery, intensive care, cardiology, nephrology, emergency department, general ward and at home. InPhoTherm addresses key areas of the HTSM Health roadmap: Healthy Living and Prevention, Diagnosis and Therapy and Home and Community Care. Projecttitel: AMPALO - Advancing Metrology to Mitigate Plasma Aging of Lithography Optics
Projectbeschrijving: Development of a state-of-the-art optical diagnostic technique that is capable of temporally and spatially resolved measurement of the densities and temperatures of volatile molecular species, both transient and stable, that are formed when surfaces are exposed to plasma produced radical fluxes created from hydrogen-nitrogen mixtures. Special emphasis will be on nitrogen species like NH, NH2 and in particular NH3, which are currently ill diagnosed yet relevant in the present context. Knowledge on temporal and spatial density distributions will be used to validate models that describe the EUV-induced plasma in the scanner.

Projecttitel: ESPRO - Patterning of 2D materials by EUV and area-selective processing
Projectbeschrijving: The goal of the project is to develop area-selective patterning processes using advanced semiconductor fabrication equipment. To this end, the impact of surface modification using EUV patterning and ALD/ALE will be studied for different materials and underlayers. ALD and ALE processes will be tailored to deposit or etch material on the modified areas selectively. The modification of two-dimensional materials enabled by EUV at different conditions provides controlled processing of these layers, e.g. doping, band-gap tuning, etc., while improving defectivity and pattern quality. Hence, this project will contribute to the HTSM roadmap Semiconductor Equipment.

Projecttitel: ICS SAXS - Hard X-ray metrology accelerated by an inverse Compton scattering source
Projectbeschrijving: We will investigate the potential of using ICS hard X-ray sources in combination with metrology tools. We will collect incidence-angle dependent diffraction patterns from samples with high aspect ratio nanostructures, with the aim to derive dimensional properties and feature sizes in 3D. Depending on sample availability, the project will explore the feasibility of various use cases, which may be for example overlay measurement through thick opaque layers, characterization of deep etches and HAR contact holes, or 3D interconnects. Also, the combination of dimensional metrology and X-ray material characterization techniques will be considered. The project goal is to determine the possibilities for metrology offered by the unique characteristics of X-ray beams generated by ICS. As such this project contributes to the HTSM roadmap Semiconductor Equipment.

The main objective of the project is to develop fundamental understanding of moving contact line instabilities in the required regime of very high velocities and accelerations. This is achieved by combining dedicated experiments and direct numerical simulations with the Volume-of-Fluid method (open-source code Basilisk). Herewith we expect to overcome the stumbling block in the understanding of the formation of undesired drops, bubbles or films, and with this understanding be able to push the onset of instabilities towards higher velocities, allowing for faster production of wafers. This will drive down semiconductor production cost and increase energy efficiency of wafer production.

Projecttitel: IDLEC - Increasing the Dynamic Load capacity of Electricity Cables
Projectbeschrijving: This research project builds on a well-established tradition of the University of Twente of advancing research in the areas of smart and innovative forms of maintenance. The goal of this research is to develop a framework (methods, models, monitoring systems) that enables Liander to dynamically load existing infrastructure components by briefly operating them above their nominal design capacity in situations where this can be safely achieved. Setting dynamic thresholds and implementing real-time monitoring of key performance parameters such as current and temperature are crucial in managing the degradation over the life cycle. In addition, a health monitoring plan is needed to implement maintenance policies for dynamic loading in a timely manner.

Projecttitel: PeTRUS - Photoacoustic-enriched Transrectal Ultrasound Imaging for improved prostate cancer diagnosis
Projectbeschrijving: We will optimize and enable photoacoustic-enriched TRUS. Photoacoustics can visualize blood vessels and measure blood oxygen saturation (sO2); higher vascularity and lower sO2 are important functional biomarkers in malignancies. The overarching project goal is thus to optimize the diagnostic capabilities of the hybrid modality in an endorectal probe under development by Seno Medical, perform a pilot study of 5 patients, and investigate how the technology can be brought into clinical practice and society. Our vision is that the integrated feature set of PeTRUS will provide a real-time map of ROIs in the gland for targeted biopsy that can potentially become the new gold standard. Fit with the roadmap Healthcare is explained in the proposal.

Projecttitel: TopTreat - TOwards Precision TREATment for advanced osteoarthritis
Projectbeschrijving: TopTreat aims to generate a unique and highly accurate technology-enabling platform that enables sophisticated phenotyping of patients with a focus on transcription factor-driven reporter bioassay technology, joint-on-a-chip technology, ambulant motion and gait sensor analyses and biomechanical modelling of joint dynamics and cartilage stress levels in order to collect more specific OA disease characteristics. Data-driven prognostic modelling and artificial intelligence allow to tailor the most optimal treatment to the needs of individual OA patients. The TopTreat program fits within the Healthcare roadmap and fits within the KIA Gezondheid en Zorg. More information about this can be found in the proposal.

The project aims on extension of recently developed algorithm for managing a single multi-functional radar (MFR) with a variety of radar system characteristics based on Lagrange Relaxation and Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDP) towards multi-sensor operation to improve situational awareness and accommodate MFR's with various system characteristics applicable either to single MFRs consisting of multiple antenna arrays (faces) or to multiple (multi-band) MFRs with various system characteristics stationed on a single or on multiple jointly operating vessels. The developed hybrid centralized-distributed algorithmic solution will offer an optimal solution at single platforms and reduce computational and communication load over multiple platforms. The project goals will help move from situational awareness towards cooperative, reactive, adaptive and predictive perception of environment around naval vehicles. These topics perfectly set the project within the Area Sensors of the Securityroadmap, in particular Active Sensorsas well as Theme Electronics for radio communication and radarof the Electronics R&D Roadmap 2.0. The project directly fits to KIA Veiligheid, mission Maritime high-tech vooreenveiligezee, subprogrammeRadar and integrated sensor suites.

Projecttitel: LUNDT - Laser Ultrasound for Non-Destructive Testing
Projectbeschrijving: The development of a non-destructive testing (NDT) system for weld inspection fits perfectly well in the roadmap Advanced Instrumentation. The aim of the proposed fundamental research is to reach - in close collaboration with our industrial partner - a proof-of-concept for a highly innovative NDT system that is unique in its kind and meets the demand from industry for contactless NDT. The primary goal of such a system is to improve the production process of the metal pillars needed for windmills. This links the project to the KIA Energy and Sustainability.

Projecttitel: GAIM - Graph-based AI Monitoring Tools for Complex-Systems
Projectbeschrijving: This project aims to develop a new monitoring technology detecting cyber threats and anomalies in future networks. The project investigates the AI methods of weakly-supervised learning and graph neural networks, using the network state, flexibility and network topology. This project advances technology development in the ICT sector in the Netherlands, specifically in future network services, and cyber-security, aiming at learning selectively from Big-Data with tailored topology-aware AI methods.

Het doel van het W4T project is om een waterstof gebaseerd opslagsystem voor overtollige zonenergie en huishoudelijk gebruik te.ontwikkelen. Dit systeem is gebaseerd op een combinatie van water elektrolyse en waterstof brandstofcellen op kilowatt schaal. Op dit.moment is PEM technologie de state of the art maar liquid alkaline en AEM electrolyers / brandstofcellen zijn poteniel attractieve en.relatief goedkope technieken. Om hiermee een veilige en stabiele energieopslag voor thuisgebruik te maken moeten we het systeem.uitbreiden met een batterij als snelle en reversibele energiebuffer. Het onderzoek richt zich dan ook op het dimensioneren van deze.batterijen en het gebruik van elektrische auto's als snelle energiebuffer..Om het systeem te complementeren zal gekeken moeten worden naar veilige opslag voor waterstof, eventueel compressie en - last.but not least - een automatische besturing van het geheel.

Projecttitel: Federated Analytics Breast Cancer Care - Federated Analytics through Harmonization in National Breast Cancer Care
Projectbeschrijving: The goal of this project is to develop (i) a generic harmonization, cleaning, and coupling approach that connects well with existing developments such as Health-RI and EHDEN; and (ii) a generic federated analytics approach where inter-organizational exchange of partial intermediate results is properly cryptographically protected. As a concrete use case, we implement the federated approach to show the benefit of connecting NBCA and DBIR for women with implant-based breast cancer reconstructions. The result of the project is also meant as a showcase within DICA to drive further connectivity between registries at patient-level.

Projecttitel: Total Surface Smoothing of Laser Powder Bed Fusion
Projectbeschrijving: The project aims to address these challenges by developing innovative smoothening techniques. The proposed research aims to explore and optimize advanced post-processing methods, drawing inspiration from fields such as nanotechnology, materials science, and mechatronics, to achieve superior surface quality for internal channels and the overall part geometry. By addressing the problems related to internal channels and total surface roughness, this research project seeks to unlock the full potential of LPBF technology and advance the field of additive manufacturing. The findings of this study will pave the way for enhanced performance, increased efficiency, and broader industrial applications in the manufacturing sector, specifically for extremely small heat exchangers and wafer plates and it will benefit the medical sector in the creation of medical and orthopaedic implants and surgical instruments.

Projectbeschrijving: Hoewel grootschalige waterzuiveringen vaak de voorkeur hebben vanwege schaalvoordelen, kan het in bepaalde gevallen nuttig zijn om juist lokaal een zuivering uit te voeren. Een goed voorbeeld hiervan zijn ziekenhuizen. Hier worden andere medicijnen gebruikt (en dus geloosd) dan de gangbare ‘gidsstoffen’. In de huidige rioolwaterzuiveringsinstallaties (RWZI’s) wordt de mate van verwijdering van gidsstoffen gebruikt als maat voor de eliminatie van medicijnen die door patiënten thuis worden gebruikt. Specifieke ziekenhuismedicijnen worden niet of nauwelijks gemeten in een RWZI. Ziekenhuismedicijnen zijn mogelijk lastig te verwijderen met de gangbare RWZI-processen, en het is niet bekend of nieuwe methodes die op dit moment voor afvalwater worden ontwikkeld ook voor ziekenhuismedicijnen werken. Door hun specifieke werking kunnen ze juist wel een grote impact hebben op het oppervlaktewater. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan specifieke antibiotica, die ziekenhuizen toepassen indien de gewone antibiotica niet (meer) effectief zijn. Het is van het grootste belang dat er in het milieu geen resistentie tegen deze reserve antibiotica ontstaat. Dit kan grote gevolgen hebben voor de bestrijding van infecties en daarom is een goede verwijdering van deze middelen uit het afvalwater gewenst. In de meeste gevallen is de bijdrage van ziekenhuizen aan het influent van RWZI’s relatief klein, maar in bepaalde gevallen, zoals in Maastricht, waar een groot ziekenhuis op een kleine RWZI loost, kan die bijdrage juist wel groot zijn. Niet alleen vanwege de vracht aan geneesmiddelen die hier in de RWZI terechtkomt, maar vooral ook wegens het karakter van die geneesmiddelen zou een lokale zuivering hier problemen kunnen oplossen. Uit eerder TKI-onderzoek met effluent van RWZI Panheel is gebleken dat geavanceerde oxidatie met behulp van een combinatie van UV-straling en waterstofperoxide (UV/H2O2) zeer effectief en efficiënt is voor de afbraak van een breed scala aan organische microverontreinigingen waaronder medicijnen (een bredere range aan medicijnen werd hiermee afgebroken dan door oxidatie met ozon). Een bijkomend voordeel van oxidatie met UV/H2O2 is dat hierbij geen bromaat wordt gevormd. Om deze techniek efficiënt toe te passen in afvalwater, moet echter de UV-transmissie van het water met een goede voorbehandeling worden verhoogd. Toepassing van een ionenwisselaar (‘ion exchange’, IEX) leidde in het Panheel-onderzoek tot een sterke verlaging van het energieverbruik van de UV-lampen, doordat de hars vrijwel alle humuszuren verwijderde. Helaas werd hierbij ook een grote regeneraatstroom gevormd. Dat is, zeker bij decentrale toepassingen, een nadeel. Het innovatieve deel van dit onderzoek betreft een vernieuwende voorbehandelingstechniek, die de waterkwaliteit voor UV-processen niet alleen sterk verbetert, maar ook tegelijkertijd nauwelijks afvalstromen genereert. De effectiviteit van het UV/H2O2-proces wordt grotendeels bepaald door het aanwezige ‘natuurlijk organisch materiaal’ (NOM).  Een biologisch actieve koolfilter (BAC) kan een deel van het NOM en de verontreinigingen adsorberen/afbreken zonder dat er een grote afvalstroom wordt gevormd. Toepassing van een biologisch actieve IEX-hars (BIEX) kan dit voordeel combineren met het voordeel van ionenwisseling: de verwijdering van juist die NOM-fractie die de effectiviteit van het UV-proces verlaagt, zonder de vorming van een grote concentraatstroom met een hoog zoutgehalte. Op deze manier zou het UV-proces veel effectiever kunnen worden ingezet, terwijl tegelijkertijd nauwelijks een afvalstroom wordt gevormd. Toepassing van zulke BIEX-harsen is een heel innovatief proces, dat nog niet of nauwelijks is beschreven in de literatuur. Daarnaast is er nog weinig bekend over de aard en vrachten van specifieke ziekenhuismedicijnen die in het afvalwater terechtkomen. UV/H2O2-processen worden in afvalwater nog nauwelijks op grote schaal toegepast, omdat het proces vanwege de samenstelling van het afvalwater meestal teveel energie vraagt. Daarom wordt er voor afvalwaterzuivering meestal gekozen voor processen gebaseerd op ozon, waarbij de vorming van bromaat echter niet kan worden voorkomen. Onlangs zijn strenge eisen gesteld aan de hoeveelheid bromaat die op het oppervlaktewater geloosd mag worden. UV/H2O2-processen vormen geen bromaat, terwijl ze bijzonder effectief zijn voor de afbraak van een breder scala aan microverontreinigingen dan ozon. Door de combinatie van een biologisch actief voorfilter en een UV/H2O2-proces wordt een innovatieve en effectieve zuivering gevormd, die nauwelijks afvalstromen en geen bromaat genereert, maar wel voorkomt dat specifieke ziekenhuismedicijnen in het milieu terechtkomen.  Omdat het proces wordt toegespitst op de afbraak van ziekenhuis selectieve medicijnen kunnen de resultaten ervan gebruikt worden tot het opstellen van een gidslijst voor de kwaliteit van zuivering bij zulke zorginstellingen; zo’n lijst is niet bestaand en het genereren ervan draagt bij aan het innovatieve karakter van dit project.

Projecttitel: Actief grondwaterpeilbeheer in de bebouwde omgeving: grondwater, infrastructuur/bebouwing en groen
Projectbeschrijving: Door stedelijke verdichting, actief ingrijpen in de bodem en klimaatverandering wordt waterbeheer in de stad steeds complexer. We zien steeds meer te natte en te droge omstandigheden optreden. Voor het oog onzichtbaar en vaak traag, veroorzaakt grondwater over- en onderlast schade aan infrastructuur, gebouwen en groen. Een te laag grondwaterpeil kan leiden tot bodemdaling, schade aan infrastructuur, zoals wegen en riolen en aantasting van fundering van woningen door paalrot en (ongelijke) zetting. Te hoge grondwaterstanden kunnen resulteren in vochtoverlast en schade aan bebouwing. Daarnaast is hitte, door een te droge bodem en niet vitaal groen, zowel boven- als ondergronds een steeds groter probleem in steden. Opwarming van de bodem veroorzaakt bovendien ongewenste temperatuurstijging van het drinkwater, wat nog wordt versterkt door voor de energietransitie benodigde uitbreiding van warmtenetten en verzwaring van elektrakabels. Een oplossing voor bovenstaande problematiek is het beperken van fluctuaties in grondwaterpeilen in stedelijk gebied. Huidige drainagestelsels zijn veelal gericht op afvoer van water boven een bepaald niveau om overlast te voorkomen. Water langer vasthouden of zelfs water aanvoeren is met deze systemen niet mogelijk. Met het zogenaamde actief grondwater peilbeheer is het mogelijk om water vast te houden voor droge periodes en zelfs actief water aan te voeren en te infiltreren en zo fluctuaties in het grondwaterpeil te verkleinen.

Dit onderzoeksprogramma onderzocht de mogelijkheden en beperkingen van adaptatie- en verdedigingsstrategieën gericht op het ‘meebewegen’ met de zeespiegelstijging, waarmee Nederland ook bij hoge scenario’s van zeespiegelstijging leefbaar gehouden kan worden (i.e. bij meer dan 2 meter stijging van de zeespiegel). Het programma onderzocht voor de lange-termijn oplossingsrichting ‘Meebewegen’ welke maatregelen (‘bouwstenen’) hiervoor denkbaar zijn en hoe deze tot technisch en fysisch realistische en uitvoerbare adaptieve strategieën geassembleerd kunnen worden. Hiertoe werd een duidingskader en ontwerprichtlijnen ontwikkeld. In het programma is ook onderzocht hoe deze maatregelen invloed kunnen hebben op andere gebruiksfuncties (o.a. natuur, recreatie, scheepvaart, visserij, woongebieden en industrie). Ook onderzochten we de mogelijkheden om functies te combineren. Hieruit is een overzicht naar voren gekomen van het doelbereik op het vlak van kustveiligheid, waterafvoer van rivieren en zoetwaterbeschikbaarheid, neveneffecten en meekoppelkansen van deze bouwstenen. Ook werd hiermee een basis gelegd voor het borgen van voldoende adaptiviteit/aanpassingsmogelijkheden van de ruimtelijke inrichting om toekomstige meebewegende oplossingsrichtingen mogelijk te houden, maar ook waar grenzen liggen aan adaptiviteit. Bevindingen van experts werden getoetst en verrijkt in een proces met partijen uit de totale kennis- en projectketen, waardoor een gezamenlijk gedragen kennisbasis ontstond tussen de overheid, kennisinstellingen en private partijen, zowel ingenieursbureaus als uitvoerend bedrijfsleven (joint-fact-finding). Resultaat is een gedragen methodiek (richtlijnen en duidingskader) voor het uitwerken en beoordelen van meebewegende oplossingen. Vervolgens werden bouwstenen in een proces van ontwerpend onderzoek samengevoegd tot onderscheidende ‘principe meebewegende oplossingsrichtingen’. De ontwikkelde methodiek is getoetst door deze toe te passen op deze principe oplossingsrichtingen en/of bestaande meebewegende plannen. Dit gaf een eerste inzicht in de kansen, beperkingen en haalbaarheid van onderscheidende principe oplossingsrichtingen. Tot slot geven de resultaten inzicht in de benodigde kennisontwikkeling- en innovatiebehoefte voor toekomstige meebewegende oplossingsrichtingen.

Projecttitel: Hoge temperatuur Kinetiek voor Furfural Synthese
Projectbeschrijving: De chemische industrie zal moeten vergroenen en verduurzamen om aan de klimaat ambities voor 2030 te voldoen. Biomassa en met name biomassa residuen zullen een belangrijke rol spelen in deze transitie en omgezet worden in zogenaamde bioraffinaderijen naar biofuels en biobased chemicals. Hiervoor zijn grote investeringen en veel research en development activiteiten noodzakelijk. GFB Europe heeft een lange termijn visie om een grote bioraffinaderij te bouwen. Het heeft technologie ontwikkeld om de hexose suikers van biomassa om te zetten naar levulinezuur en derivaten. In een dergelijke bioraffinaderij zal het belangrijk zijn om naast de hexose suikers (cellulose) ook de pentose suikers (hemicellulose) om te zetten naar nuttige producten. Een van de mogelijke producten uit hemicellulose is furfural. Voor het ontwerp van de reactor is fundamenteel inzicht in de snelheid van de omzetting naar furfural essentieel. Echter deze is niet beschikbaar voor temperaturen tussen 180 en 240oC. maken en zal in deze studie bepaald worden.

Use of fossil-based, non-biodegradable plastics has led to several environmental problems such as CO2 emissions, the .‘plastic soup’ and microplastics release into the environment. Bio-based, biodegradable plastics such as polylactic acid .(PLA) offer a sustainable alternative, but these are not yet used to their full potential. In the current waste treatment .system, PLA is not (completely) composted or categorized as ‘other’ in plastics recycling. As a result, most PLA is .incinerated at the end of life. This project will address the recycling of PLA to offer a true circular solution. .Mechanical recycling is an option for clean PLA streams, however the mechanically recycled PLA will be of lower quality .and will not be suitable for applications that require virgin plastics. Hydrothermal treatment has high potential for .recycling of PLA from mixed or contaminated streams into monomers suitable for the production of virgin PLA. In this .project, monomers (lactic acid or LA) will be obtained from different PLA waste streams and assessed for their purity. .Based on the results, purification steps might be proposed targeting a feedstock for production of virgin PLA. An initial .assessment of process economics, energy savings and environmental impact will be made during the project.
